summary: tri-Crescendo and Bandai Namco's Chopin-inspired JRPG, originally on Xbox 360 and later expanded on PlayStation 3.

entries.title: Eternal Sonata

emulation.notes: Use legal disc dumps and test the current compatibility profile before committing to a full run.

primary.why: The PlayStation 3 version adds exclusive playable characters, costumes, story/content changes, and dungeons over the Xbox 360 original; RPCS3 is the highest-fidelity capture route for that more complete version.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped PlayStation 3 disc in RPCS3, testing stability and shader compilation before a full stream. Original PS3 hardware is the fallback if emulation issues appear.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster exists; the PlayStation 3 release remains the content-complete version.
